title: Continuous-function set presheaf on the small pro-etale site
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For any topological space $D$, in compatible universes with $X$ in universe $u$ and $D$ in universe $u+1$, define the set presheaf $F_{D,X}$ by $F_{D,X}(U)=C(|U|,D)$, the continuous maps from the underlying Zariski space of $U$ to $D$. For a morphism $f:V\to U$ over $X$, restriction is precomposition, $s\mapsto s\circ|f|$. Equivalently this is the restriction of the continuous-map presheaf on schemes along the forgetful functor from the small pro-etale site to schemes. No separation, disconnectedness, compactness or group hypothesis on $D$ is part of this definition.
